scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend && cd backend && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend && cd backend && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir frontend lint && cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.test: pnpm --dir frontend test && cd backend && uv run pytest -q
scripts.check:fast: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run check:fast && pnpm run test
